title: b7z9.25.1: Python+Rust: implement SYNCED->DESYNCED on >=3 missed superframes
description: Spec 02a pseudocode OnMissedSuperframe() has a SYNCED path: MissedSuperframes>=3 -> DESYNCED. Python sfn.py:116-118 early-returns unless RECOVERING (skips SYNCED path). Rust desync.rs has no missed_superframes field or on_missed_superframe() method at all. Fix: (1) Python: remove early return, add SYNCED->DESYNCED branch; (2) Rust: add missed_superframes field, implement on_missed_superframe() matching Python. Update tests.
